 Print Mahhi Vij apologised to Love Gill and her mother following the controversy surrounding a remark allegedly made about Love. However, Love refused to accept her apology, saying that her mother had been hurt by the incident. The latest episode of Bigg Boss 20 also witnessed emotional family messages, sacrifices and fresh arguments among the contestants. The controversy began after Love received a message from her mother, who claimed that Mahhi had said she was staying quiet because of ScoutOP and would otherwise expose Love. She also advised Love to focus on her individual game and avoid getting emotionally attached to other contestants. Watch From Riya Ahir, Mahhi Vij to Qazi Touqeer, here’s the contestant lineup for Bigg Boss 20 Mahhi denied making the alleged remark but later apologised to Love and her mother. Love maintained that she could not overlook the incident as it had hurt her mother. Mahhi said she wanted to apologise regardless of whether Love accepted it. The controversy also left her emotional, and she questioned how the makers were portraying her on the show. Poll Vote & Share your view

Love explained that her mother’s message had made her rethink certain relationships inside the house. She also admitted that Scout could be among those talking behind her back. Another major moment involved Mahhi and Arishfa. When Mahhi received an opportunity to let Arishfa hear her family’s message, she chose to break the cassette to protect her lifeline. Despite Arishfa asking her to reconsider she stood by her decision, saying she wanted to win the show for her child. Arishfa later called her selfish, further straining their relationship.
